title: BetterTogether Profiling Record
description: One self-describing measurement of a single (stage, processing-unit) under one scenario, on one device, in one run. The canonical profiling store is JSON Lines: one file per run (run-NNN.jsonl), one record per line, each line validating against this schema. Emitted by the bm-prof-* profiler; consumed by the Python loader before the data ever reaches the SMT solver. Replaces the old print-text -> regex -> half-wide CSV path.

schema.description: Format tag. Bump when the record shape changes so loaders can refuse data they don't understand.

device.description: Device id, matching a devices/<id>.json stem (e.g. 'minipc', '3A021JEHN02756').

backend.description: GPU backend the binary was built for. The CPU tiers are always OMP; this names the accelerator path.

scenario.description: 'isolated' = the measured PU runs alone. 'interference' = other PUs are saturated by a co-runner during measurement (the paper's BTPM condition).

run.description: Run number. Also encoded in the filename (run-NNN.jsonl); duplicated here so a record is self-contained once detached from its file.

stage.description: 1-based pipeline stage index within the app.

pu.description: Processing unit the stage ran on. A self-describing field, NOT a CSV column position -- absent PUs simply produce no record rather than a silent 0.

timing.description: Per-iteration timing distribution, not a single throughput-mean.

cv.description: Coefficient of variation (stddev/mean); the noise gate the loader filters on.

provenance.description: What was true when the row was measured -- so the table is self-explaining, reproducible, and auditable. Open to extra MEASURED fields (e.g. a future 'throttled' once thermals are sampled); a field absent here means it was not measured, never assume a default.

git_sha.description: Short git sha of the binary, stamped at build time. 'unknown' if built outside a git tree.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the run.

freq_governor.description: cpu0 scaling_governor read from /sys at runtime; 'unknown' where unreadable.

freq_locked.description: Derived: governor is 'performance' or 'userspace' (DVFS effectively pinned).
